title: Virtual Browser is a non-rendering application runtime
summary: Virtual Browser automates web applications through HTML/DOM/JavaScript semantics and browser-like sessions without paying the cost of a GUI renderer when pixels are not needed.
invariants: Virtual Browser is not a scraper abstraction and is not headless Chrome by default.
Commands are semantic browser operations such as navigate, set value, activate, submit, wait, read and enumerate.
HTML/DOM/application state is authoritative; visual rasterisation is absent from normal execution.
Images, fonts, media, analytics, advertising, preload and prefetch are suppressed by default unless semantically required.
CSS semantics may be implemented where application behaviour depends on them without requiring a visual renderer.
A separate FULL_BROWSER_REQUIRED capability may be used for sites that genuinely depend on layout, canvas, WebGL, WebAuthn or browser-specific behaviour.

provenance.claim: v0.9 identifies the component as a non-rendering semantic browser and preserves API/placement authority boundaries.
